Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableAddedWeather: Allows Changing Skies to ask the vanilla weather system to generate additional weather events.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherFreque: Controls the chance for an added weather event, rolled every 10 in-game minutes. Cooldowns and naturally occurring weather add more time between checks.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherSeveri: Controls the strength range for an added weather event. This does not set an exact weather type or duration.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMinimumHou: Minimum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMaximumHou: Maximum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableTemperatureA: Applies the chosen seasonal temperatures while retaining vanilla daily and weather variation.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringColdTargetF_: Cold target for spring (March-May). Vanilla Normal reference: 37.5 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringWarmTargetF_: Warm target for spring (March-May). Vanilla Normal reference: 66.3 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerColdTargetF_: Cold target for summer (June-August). Vanilla Normal reference: 60.2 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerWarmTargetF_: Warm target for summer (June-August). Vanilla Normal reference: 89.0 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallColdTargetF_to: Cold target for fall (September-November). Vanilla Normal reference: 42.4 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallWarmTargetF_to: Warm target for fall (September-November). Vanilla Normal reference: 71.2 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterColdTargetF_: Cold target for winter (December-February). Vanilla Normal reference: 19.9 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterWarmTargetF_: Warm target for winter (December-February). Vanilla Normal reference: 48.7 F. Ordinary daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_DebugLogging_toolt: Writes concise scheduler and temperature diagnostics to the game log. Disabled by default.
